items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I went to him. He was glad to sell them to me for cost.

ctx.x: He recorded me, and he did not pay for the record session: Cal Tjader, Ron Crotty, and myself. So when I asked him – I said, “My sidemen are complaining that they haven’t been paid and the records are out.” He said, “I can’t pay you, because they’re not selling at all.” So I went to the Weiss brothers, who produced those records – Jack Sheedy was his name.
